title: The Setting That Was Converted: What QVariant Does to 3.7, to 3e9 and to the Word "no"
fallback: This lesson is about what QVariant converts silently, so it needs Qt. Lesson 01-15 is about conversions between number types in plain C++, and lesson 00-10 about a number that arrives as text. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: whole numbers, true or false and numbers taken from a QVariant, each refused when the conversion would change the value
